description: Physically control a robot with a Network service token. POST /robots/:id/estop latches the e-stop for any robot id and needs bot.robot.read as well; Bot records the service as the actor and does not check X-OV-Subject. On the operator WebSocket (/control) a token with this capability must name a person in X-OV-Subject, and Bot applies that person's role (owner, operator or queue), allowlist and limits. Clearing the e-stop is bot.robot.manage.
